findings.location: While reflecting on solitary aspect paragraph (Mark 6:46) in source.html
findings.source_quote: "It is easy to focus on the prayer aspect of this passage, and that is important, but let's focus on the solitary aspect of this experience. Jesus even left His closest followers behind during this time of seeking God’s face."
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the mistranslated word "enebolige" with an idiomatic Norwegian rendering that conveys "solitary" or "being alone". For example: "la oss rette oppmerksomheten mot den ensomme siden av denne erfaringen" or "...mot den enslige siden av denne erfaringen." Preserve surrounding HTML and punctuation exactly as in the translation.
findings.translation_quote: "Det er lett å fokusere på bønnaspektet i denne teksten, og det er viktig, men la oss rette oppmerksomheten mot den enebolige siden av denne erfaringen. Jesus forlot til og med sine nærmeste etterfølgere i denne tiden da han søkte Guds åsyn."

findings.source_quote: "It is as though you are in a vehicle traveling 90 mph, and you push the accelerator a little harder, and nothing happens."
findings.suggested_fix: The translation converted 90 mph into 145 km/t. While localization is permitted, to keep closer fidelity to the author's numeric example you may either (a) keep the original figure in parentheses after the localized number, e.g. "145 km/t (ca. 90 mph)", or (b) keep the original 90 mph as-is if the publication prefers not to convert. Make only this narrow change; do not alter the rest of the sentence. Preserve surrounding HTML.
